prereg.motivation: The earlier 'box' test (every criterion inside its 2-sigma interval at once) rejects a correct model with probability 1 - 0.9545^8 = 0.31 for 8 independent data; it is not a proper goodness-of-fit test. The standard test is a joint likelihood; it is declared here before any number is computed and applied identically to NVG, NL3, FSUGold and DD-ME2.

6_Lt_GW170817.source: Abbott et al. 2019 PRX 9 011001, low-spin prior, 300 +420/-230 (90%); sigma = half-width / 1.645

7_S2_0p10.definition: S_2(n) = (1/2) d^2(E/A)/d delta^2 at delta = 0 (NVG: k_F^2/(6 E_F*) + C(n) n/8 on the symmetric branch)

8_EPNM_0p10.definition: E/N of pure neutron matter at 0.10 fm^-3 (eps/n - m_N)

term_rules.radius_and_lambda: chi2_k = ((pred - c)/s)^2 with s = sp if pred > c else sm (two-piece Gaussian); L_k = exp(-chi2_k/2)
term_rules.unsupported_star: if M_max < M of a radius datum (1.34, 1.418, 1.44) or < 1.36 for GW170817: that star cannot exist in the model -> L_k = 0 (chi2 = +inf)
term_rules.normalisation: L = exp(-chi2/2) (product of the 8 terms). Density normalisation constants are identical for every model and cancel in Bayes factors
term_rules.statistic: chi2 = sum of the 8 terms; fixed-model p-value = chi2.sf(chi2, nu=8); a Monte-Carlo replicated-data p-value with the generative model below is also reported

rotation.prescription: Hartle 1967 / Hartle-Thorne 1968 second order in Omega.  l=0 (m0, p0*) and l=2 (h2, k2) interior systems, centre data and vacuum matching taken unchanged from the repository module verification/nvg_hartle_second_order_quadrupole_probe.py (Urbanec-Miller-Stuchlik 2013 MNRAS 433 1906; Yagi-Yunes 2013 PRD 88 023009). Surface displacement xi_l = -p_l* (eps+p)/(dp/dr) at r = R, p2* = -h2 - r^2 e^-nu omega_bar^2/3. Circumferential equatorial radius at fixed central pressure: R_eq = R + xi0 - xi2/2 - R k2/2. Fixed gravitational mass: R_eq(M) = R_s(M) + [R_eq - R](Pc*) - (dR_s/dM) dM, dM = m0(R) + J^2/R^3 (bulk; the Reina 2015 surface term is O(eps_surf) and negligible at P_surf = 1e-9).
rotation.J0740_rule: if M_max >= 2.07 and M_max - 2.07 >= 3 dM(2.07): fixed-mass formula; if 2.07 <= M_max < 2.07 + 3 dM: fixed-central-pressure correction (flagged); if M_max < 2.07: fixed-central-pressure correction at the M_max configuration (flagged)
rotation.Mmax_term: static M_max (not rotation corrected; the HT mass increase at the M_max configuration is reported as a diagnostic)
validation: constant-density star C -> 0 vs Maclaurin (xi2/(Omega_bar^2 R) -> -5/6; fixed-mass R_eq/R - 1 -> (5/12) Omega_bar^2)
oblateness 1 - R_pole/R_eq vs the universal fit Omega_bar^2 (0.788 - 1.030 x) (Morsink et al. 2007 ApJ 663 1244; AlGendy & Morsink 2014 ApJ 791 78) for DD-ME2 and NL3
moment of inertia vs Lattimer & Schutz 2005 ApJ 629 979 fit
static M, R of the background pass vs nvg_forward_band.solve_tov_tidal

nvg_class.prior: uniform on the declared windows of closure/run_band.py WINDOWS, Latin hypercube (run_band.lhs_params), N = 2000, seed 20261106, ids lk0000..lk1999
nvg_class.model: power-law isovector running, scenario A (J = sampled J), declared scalar rule (quartic if globally stable, else quintic with a5 from Q0 if stable, else no stable model), thermodynamically consistent pressure, SLy crust (Read+2009, eps-continuity match), P_surf = 1e-9
nvg_class.numerics: nvg_forward_band.DEFAULT_SETTINGS except n_pc = 40 (closure/samples_conv.jsonl: n_pc 40 vs 70 changes R(1.44) by < 1.2e-4 km, M_max by < 2e-6); masses (1.0, 1.27, 1.34, 1.36, 1.4, 1.418, 1.44, 1.46, 1.8, 2.07)
likelihood_zero: no stellar branch / crust match failure (counted and reported separately)
nvg_class.ground_state_valid: (a) beta-equilibrium table: tracked branch is the global minimum over y (BetaSolver.global_min_check) at every node with x_match <= x <= x_c(M_max); (b) symmetric matter: design branch (continued from (n0, y*)) is a local (C_y > 0) and global minimum over y at x = 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.3 (the abnormal_scan2 densities); (c) the SNM and PNM states at 0.10 fm^-3 used in terms 7-8 are global minima over y
nvg_class.causality: max c_s^2 on the stellar branch recorded as a flag, not part of the likelihood

statistics.evidence: Z = (1/N) sum_i L_i over all N prior points (L = 0 where no valid model); MC error std(L)/sqrt(N); fixed models: Z = L; Bayes factor B = Z_NVG / L_model
statistics.posterior: importance weights w_i proportional to L_i over the prior samples; ESS = (sum w)^2 / sum w^2
statistics.ppc: posterior predictive p = Pr(T(y_rep, theta) >= T(y_obs, theta)), T = chi2; 40000 posterior draws (seed 7); radii, Lambda: y_rep = pred + two-piece normal noise (sm above the prediction, sp below: the measurement model of the declared likelihood); nuclear: Gaussian; mass datum: latent true mass m ~ N(2.08, 0.07) truncated to m <= M_max(theta) (flat prior), m_rep = m + N(0, 0.07), T_1 = -2 ln Phi((M_max - m_rep)/0.07). Fixed models: the same with theta fixed
statistics.loo: for datum k: weights w_i^(-k) = exp(-sum_{j != k} chi2_ij / 2); predictive of d_k = mixture of the measurement distribution around pred_k(theta_i); z_k = Phi^-1(u_k), u_k = sum w F(d_obs | theta) (PIT; primary); moment z also reported; mass datum (one-sided): P_host = sum w Phi((M_max - 2.08)/0.07), z_1 = -Phi^-1(P_host) if P_host < 0.5 else 0; samples that cannot host star k are reported as p_nohost
statistics.best_point: max L over the prior samples; p-values with nu = 8 (naive) and nu = 1 (all 7 parameters counted as fitted) bracket the look-elsewhere effect
statistics.summaries: weighted mean and 16/50/84% quantiles of the 7 parameters and of R_1.0, R_1.8 (static), M_max, Lambda_1.4, K_sym, L, P_beta(2 n0) (consistent pressure)
statistics.box: 2 sigma: M_max >= 1.94 and |z_k| <= 2 for terms 2-8; 1 sigma: M_max >= 2.01 and |z_k| <= 1; earlier-report convention M_max >= 2.01 for both also given

prereg.convergence_criterion: NVG class 'converges without fitting' iff, with the SLy crust and consistent pressure and rotation-corrected radii, posterior predictive p > 0.05 AND every leave-one-out |z| < 2 AND the ground-state condition holds on the posterior support
sensitivity_not_criterion: J0614 left out entirely (7 data, nu = 7)
prereg.extra_class: minimal-sextic structural class (declared rule with minimal-a6 sextic fallback for 'no stable model' points), on a subsample if time allows; reported separately

spin_orbit.observable: 16O 1p spin-orbit splitting Delta E = E(1p1/2) - E(1p3/2)
spin_orbit.experiment_source: neutron 1p splitting from 15O/17O single-particle energies (session declared protocol, value as recalled; proton 6.32)

procedure_primary_LDA.density: rho(r) = rho_c/(1 + exp((r - R)/a)), R = 1.12 A^(1/3) - 0.86 A^(-1/3) fm, a = 0.54 fm, int rho = A; the same profile for every model
procedure_primary_LDA.local_fields: S(n), V(n) of the model's homogeneous symmetric matter at n = rho(r) (RMF: S = -Phi, V = g_w w0 (+ Sigma_R for DD); NVG: S = M(y-1), V = C_v n/y^2 on the design branch)
procedure_primary_LDA.spin_orbit_potential: V_so = (hbar c)^2/(2 M_eff^2) (1/r) d(V - S)/dr, M_eff = M - (V - S)/2, M = 939 MeV
procedure_primary_LDA.central_potential: U_SEP = S + V + (S^2 - V^2)/(2M) + (e/M) V at the level's own energy, iterated to |de| < 1e-5 MeV; Woods-Saxon fit on 0 <= r <= R + 10 a
procedure_primary_LDA.splitting: first order: Delta E = -(2l+1)/2 int u^2 V_so dr; FD Schroedinger h = 0.01 fm, box 20 fm
procedure_primary_LDA.exact_dirac_variant: radial Dirac eigenvalues in the same LDA potentials (kappa = -2 and +1, nr = 1), no WS fit, no perturbation theory; robustness variant, not the declared statistic

spin_orbit.validation_rule: NL3 and DD-ME2 raw LDA 16O 1p within 6.18 +- 20 percent ([4.944, 7.416] MeV) -> raw LDA numbers used for every model; otherwise one global scale factor fixed by NL3 and DD-ME2 only
spin_orbit.source: session spin-orbit protocol (creative/spin_orbit/declared.py, so_core.py, run_spin_orbit.splittings); round-3 RMF survey (rmf_survey/run_survey.py)

joint_verdict.O_spin_orbit: 16O 1p splitting from the validated LDA procedure in [4.9, 7.4] MeV
joint_verdict.G_ground_state: no Lee-Wick abnormal state below the stellar central density (RMF: global minimum over 0 <= M* <= M at 120 SNM + 60 beta densities from 0.02 n0 to n_c(M_max); NVG: tracked branch is the global minimum over y on the beta table between the crust match and x_c(M_max), SNM at x = 0.05..1.3, SNM and PNM at 0.10 fm^-3)

interpretation.summary: Every built-in model fails the declared joint verdict. Standard RMF sets pass 16O and the ground state but fail the stars (J0614 radius |z_PIT| > 2 for all four); the NVG members fail 16O (m*/M >= 0.84 gives 1.0-1.5 MeV against [4.9, 7.4]). See model_table for chi2, p, J0614 z and 16O of each model.
interpretation.practical_use: evaluate_table(n_fm3, eps, P, S2_0p10=..., EPNM_0p10=..., fields=(n, S, V)) puts any beta-equilibrium EOS through the same crust, stars, rotation, likelihood and 16O procedure; CLI --table FILE does the same from a 3-column file.
interpretation.evidence: evidence weight 0.0: fixed published or declared models compared with held-out data; no parameter is fitted here
